title.narrative: Provision of institutional strengthening support to WLSA Swaziland

description.narrative:
This project seeks to amplify the voices of Swazi women regarding their issues of concern in terms of their socio-economic, legal and political circumstances. Through the ‘strengthening the rights and voices of women in Swaziland’ project, our partner, WLSA Swaziland, aims to identify the aspirations around which women in Swaziland can act collectively. This project seeks to strengthen WLSA Swaziland's capacity to more effectively represent “the voice” of women’s rights in Swaziland.
To effectively reach the agreed Match Fund targets, WLSA Swaziland and CAFOD have agreed that there is a need for additional resources to strengthen WLSA, and to engage a full-time Project Officer who would support the Project Manager over the remaining months and to ensure that it effectively reaches targets under the DFID Match Fund.
